learning_outcomes.text: Providing information about air, water, and soil pollution and their causes.
Introducing methods for preventing environmental pollution.
Offering insights into the economic, social impacts of environmental pollution, and legal regulations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, Environmental pollution issues in Turkey and worldwide, atmospheric pollution, components polluting the atmosphere, industrial activities, and pollutants originating from combustion.
Water pollution, treatment of domestic and industrial wastewater, chemical and biological treatment methods.
Soil pollution, its sources, prevention, solid waste, collection, storage, and disposal.
Economic and social impacts of environmental pollution and legal regulations.
bibliography: The Nalco Water Handbook, Mc Graw Hill, 1988.
